story:
SETS (make each one a cast member of kind "set" and give every shot the set of the place it shows):
1. Brighton seafront: the pier and its shingle beach by the sea (kit place: beach); morning wind, afternoon, golden dusk
2. Grandfather's kitchen with a wooden table and a window (kit place: kitchen); morning light

On a windy autumn morning in Brighton, eight-year-old Maya flies her red kite above the pier. A gust slams it into the pier railings, and the red sail tears from corner to corner. Maya runs home along the seafront, the broken kite hugged to her chest. Her grandfather, who mended sails when he was young, looks up from his newspaper. At the kitchen table he lays the kite flat and threads a needle with sailcloth thread. Stitch by stitch, he shows Maya how a sailor's seam holds against the wind. Maya paints a small gold star over the patch, so the kite will remember. In the afternoon they walk back to the beach together, the kite under Grandfather's arm. Maya runs into the wind, and the kite climbs higher than ever over the waves. She hands the string to her grandfather, and he laughs like a boy. At golden dusk they walk home along the sand, the mended kite on Maya's shoulder.

bible.title: The Mended Kite
bible.logline: A gust tears a child's kite; a grandfather's sailor stitch and a gold star teach the wind to forgive.

cast.name: Maya
cast.look: Small eight‑year‑old with rounded face, rosy cheeks, red wool coat, yellow rubber boots, and a signature red kite string looped around her wrist.

cast.name: Grandfather
cast.look: Elderly man with soft white hair, wire‑rim glasses, navy wool sweater, rolled‑up sleeves revealing a faded sailor’s anchor tattoo on his forearm.

cast.name: Red Kite
cast.look: Diamond‑shaped red sail on lightweight bamboo frame; initially intact, then torn corner‑to‑corner, then patched with white sailcloth thread and a tiny gold star over the patch.

states.look: Bright red sail, smooth and taut on the frame.
A long rip from corner to corner, the sail flapping loose.
Patch of white thread sealing the rip, a small gold star painted over the mend.

cast.name: Brighton Seafront
cast.look: Victorian pier with wooden railings, shingle beach, rolling sea, colorful beach huts and a bandstand under a wide sky.

cast.name: Grandfather's Kitchen
cast.look: Cozy kitchen with a sturdy wooden table, lace‑curtained window letting in soft morning light, rustic shelves and a kettle.

shots.description: Wide shot of Brighton pier at windy autumn morning, Maya stands on shingle beach flying a bright red kite high above the railings, golden morning light glints on the sea.
shots.dialogue: On a windy autumn morning in Brighton, eight-year-old Maya flies her red kite above the pier.

shots.description: Medium shot close to the pier railings as a sudden gust slams the kite into the wood, the red sail rips from corner to corner, fibers flutter in the wind.
shots.dialogue: A gust slams it into the pier railings, and the red sail tears from corner to corner.

shots.description: Pan from behind Maya as she runs along the shingle promenade toward home, the broken kite hugged to her chest, colorful beach huts blur past, morning light soft.
shots.dialogue: Maya runs home along the seafront, the broken kite hugged to her chest.

shots.description: Medium shot inside grandfather's kitchen at morning light, grandfather sits at wooden table reading newspaper, looks up as Maya enters, window shows pale sky.
shots.dialogue: Her grandfather, who mended sails when he was young, looks up from his newspaper.

shots.description: Close-up on the kitchen table as grandfather lays the torn kite flat, threads a needle with white sailcloth thread, morning sun casts a warm glow on the wood.
shots.dialogue: At the kitchen table he lays the kite flat and threads a needle with sailcloth thread.

shots.description: Over-the-shoulder shot from Maya's perspective as grandfather stitches a sailor's seam, each stitch pulls the torn edges together, the kite gradually mends under his hands.
shots.dialogue: Stitch by stitch, he shows Maya how a sailor's seam holds against the wind.

shots.description: Close-up of Maya's hand painting a tiny gold star over the fresh patch on the kite, the star glints in the morning light.
shots.dialogue: Maya paints a small gold star over the patch, so the kite will remember.

shots.description: Wide shot of Brighton seafront in bright afternoon, grandfather and Maya walk side by side along the sand, the mended kite rests under grandfather's arm, colorful beach huts and bandstand frame the scene.
shots.dialogue: In the afternoon they walk back to the beach together, the kite under Grandfather's arm.

shots.description: Low angle shot as Maya runs into the wind on the beach, the kite lifts from grandfather's arm and climbs higher than ever over the rolling waves, golden afternoon light sparkles on the sea.
shots.dialogue: Maya runs into the wind, and the kite climbs higher than ever over the waves.

shots.description: Medium two-shot as Maya hands the kite string to grandfather, he laughs like a boy, the kite tugs gently in the breeze.
shots.dialogue: She hands the string to her grandfather, and he laughs like a boy.

shots.description: Wide shot at golden dusk on the shingle beach, Maya and grandfather walk home along the sand, the mended kite rests on Maya's shoulder, the pier lights glow behind them.
shots.dialogue: At golden dusk they walk home along the sand, the mended kite on Maya's shoulder.
